title: COVID-19 detection in chest X-ray images using deep boosted hybrid learning
summary: A boosted hybrid of deep CNN features and a conventional classifier reached 98.53% accuracy on radiologist-authenticated chest X-rays; no patient-outcome effect is established.
organization: Pakistan Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences
